item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
6th WIMPA · Washington International Mobile Photography Awards 2026 · Mobile Vision. Global Stories.

Categories & Rules

A platform where the phone in your pocket becomes a window for discovering and recording life. Tell the stories around you, share the many colors of life behind the lens, and show the creativity and charm of mobile photography through a unique point of view, clever ideas and diverse forms of expression.

Key Dates

Timeline

November 1, 2026Entries open
December 31, 2026Entries close at 24:00 U.S. Eastern Time
JudgingMultiple anonymous rounds by the international jury
Awards ceremonyWashington, D.C. area

Groups & Categories

Two groups, four categories

The 6th WIMPA has a Theme Group and an Open Group, each with two categories. Each category is entered, judged and awarded separately.

GroupCategory
Group 1 · Theme: "Home"Single Photo
Photo Series (4–6 images)
Group 2 · OpenNature & Landscape
Art & Creativity

Group 1 · Theme: "Home"

Home is more than a place where we live: it holds our memories, emotions, and sense of belonging, serving as a spiritual anchor wherever life may take us.

Home is where we live. It is also memory, emotion and belonging, the spiritual harbor of a life on the move. Use your photographs to tell the bonds between people and family, land, nature and culture, and to express your memories of home, how you protect and love it, and what you hope for it.

Show the land that raised you, the mountains and rivers your heart longs for, or a familiar corner of your city. Photograph family, friends and pets, and the nature, culture and daily scenes that carry human warmth. Entries may be straight documentary, or may express your idea of "home" creatively through concept, viewpoint, light and technique.

  • Single Photo: one photograph per entry.
  • Photo Series: a group of 4–6 photographs on the same subject, entered as one work. Up to three series per entrant.
  • Shooting location: entrants must state where each photo was taken. To protect privacy, give only the city, state or province, and country; no street address is needed. Locations will be a featured part of this year's awards.
  • Allowed capture methods: the phone's built-in camera and camera apps, including long exposure and intentional camera movement (ICM).

Post-processing allowed: standard adjustments to exposure, contrast, white balance, color and sharpness; cropping and horizon correction; dust-spot removal and noise reduction; AI-assisted noise reduction, masking and subject selection; multiple exposures and focus stacking that comply with these rules.

Not allowed: changing the composition or substance of the original scene; using generative fill, generative expand or any other generative AI tool to create or alter image content; submitting work created wholly or partly by AI.

Group 2 · Open

Single photographs on any subject other than the "Home" theme. Photo series are not accepted in this group.

I. Nature & Landscape. Natural elements such as animals, plants or natural phenomena, or works with the landscape as the main subject. Allowed: standard adjustments to exposure, contrast, white balance, color and sharpness; cropping and horizon correction; dust-spot removal and noise reduction. Not allowed: changing the composition or substance of the original scene; adding, replacing, moving or removing compositional elements; using generative AI tools to create or alter substantive content; submitting work created wholly or partly by AI.

II. Art & Creativity. Any subject. We encourage every kind of photographic, creative and artistic technique to express your ideas, emotions and imagination. Post-processing and re-creation are unrestricted, including abstract and conceptual images and visual art. Work created wholly or partly by AI is not accepted.

Awards

Prizes

US$5,600  in total cash awards across four categories.

Each of the four categories (Home · Single Photo, Home · Photo Series, Nature & Landscape, Art & Creativity) awards:

AwardWinners per categoryPrize
Gold Award1$500
Silver Award2$300 each
Bronze Award3$100 each
Honorable MentionSeveralCertificate of Honor

Entry Requirements

Before you submit

  • All entries must be original work taken by the entrant with a mobile phone, tablet or iPad.
  • Each entry must have a title; a brief description is encouraged.
  • Color and black-and-white works are both accepted.
  • No watermarks, signatures or borders.
  • Keep the original files and complete photo information. The organizers may request originals for verification.
  • There is no restriction on when a photo was taken.
  • JPEG format, with the long side at least 1,024 pixels and a file size of no more than 10 MB.
  • Works that won any award in a previous Washington Mobile Photography Awards are not accepted.
  • Entries will not be returned. By entering, participants authorize the Awards and the organizing committee to use their works free of charge for positive promotion and display.
  • Members of the organizing committee and the jury may not enter.
  • Portraits already used, or intended, for commercial purposes are not accepted. If a work includes an identifiable person, the entrant must obtain the subject's permission in advance and ensure the work does not infringe anyone's privacy or portrait rights. Entrants bear sole legal responsibility for their entries.
  • Entries submitted through commercial photography agencies are not accepted.
  • Photographers under 18 must have a parent or adult guardian submit on their behalf.
  • Works promoting violence, or containing pornographic, vulgar or otherwise inappropriate content, are prohibited, as are works whose main purpose is commercial advertising or product promotion.
  • Use of AI: no visual element generated wholly or partly by generative AI may be submitted. Basic AI-assisted editing tools such as de-noise, masking, subject selection and tone adjustment are allowed.

How to Submit

Submission & fees

Each entrant may submit up to six works, including up to three photo series in the "Home" theme (each series counts as one work).

Works 1–2Free
Works 3–6$10.00 (USD) per work; entrants outside the U.S. may pay the equivalent in other currencies

Global (all regions except Mainland China)

Submit through the official competition website, www.gwmpa.org, from November 1 to December 31, 2026.

Mainland China

Submit through the official WeChat channel. The QR code will be published in late October 2026.

item.title: 参赛类别与规则
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
第六届 WIMPA · 2026 华盛顿国际手机摄影大赛 · 手机视界，全球故事

参赛类别与规则

为手机摄影爱好者搭建一个分享与交流的平台，让便携的手机成为发现与记录生活的窗口，随时捕捉并分享精彩瞬间。通过作品讲述身边的故事，感受镜头背后丰富多彩的人生；以独特的视角、巧妙的构思和多元的表达，展现手机摄影的创意与魅力。

重要日期

时间安排

2026年11月1日开始征稿
2026年12月31日截稿（美东时间 24:00 整）
评审国际评委会多轮匿名评审
颁奖典礼大华府地区

参赛组别

两大组，四个类别

本届比赛分为命题组和开放组两大组，各设两个参赛类别，共计四个参赛类别。各类别独立投稿、独立评审、分别设奖。

组别类别
第一组 · 命题组《家园》《家园》单幅
《家园》组照（4–6 张）
第二组 · 开放组自然·风光
艺术·创意

第一组 · 命题组《家园》

家园，是我们居住的地方，更是一种记忆、情感与归属，是漂泊人生中的精神归处。

用照片讲述人与家庭、土地、自然、文化之间的情感连接与共生关系，表达对家园的记忆、守护、热爱与憧憬。

作品可以展现养育我们的土地、心之所向的山河、熟悉的城市角落；记录家人、朋友、宠物，以及承载人间温度的自然生态、文化与生活场景。作品既可以采用真实记录的方式，也可以通过拍摄构思、视角、光影和表现手法，创造性地表达对“家园”的理解、情感与思考。

  • 单片：单张照片。
  • 组图：相同主题内容下的一组照片，4–6 张作为一组，每人最多可投 3 组。
  • 投稿附加备注：投稿时须填写拍摄地点。它不仅是作品信息的一部分，也将成为本届大赛的一项特色。为保护个人隐私，拍摄地点填写城市、州／省及国家即可，无须提供具体住址。
  • 允许的拍摄与创作方式：允许使用手机的机内拍摄功能及手机 App 拍摄；允许采用长曝光、摇拍（ICM，Intentional Camera Movement）等摄影技法。

后期处理允许：对曝光、对比度、白平衡、色彩、锐度等进行常规调整；裁剪和画面水平校正；去除传感器灰斑及降噪处理；使用 AI 辅助的降噪、蒙版和主体选择等工具；符合本规则要求的多重曝光和焦点堆栈作品。

不允许：通过后期处理改变原始场景的构成或实质性内容；使用生成式填充、生成式扩展或其他生成式 AI 工具创造或改变画面内容；提交完全或部分由 AI 创造生成的作品。

第二组 · 开放组

参赛者可在本组提交除“家园”主题以外的单张手机摄影作品，没有其他命题限制。本组不收组图。

I.《自然、风光类》表现主体：自然元素可以是动物、植物或自然现象等；景观类或风光类作品应以景观为表现主体。后期允许：对曝光、对比度、白平衡、色彩、锐度等进行常规调整；裁剪和画面水平校正；去除传感器灰斑及降噪处理。不允许：通过后期改变原始场景的构成或实质性内容；添加、替换、移动或删除画面中的构图元素；使用生成式 AI 工具创造或改变画面实质性内容；提交完全或部分由 AI 创造生成的作品。

II.《艺术、创意类》题材不限，鼓励运用各种摄影、创意及艺术手法，表达个人的观念、情感与想象。允许后期二次创作，后期技术手段不设限制；允许后期创造抽象或观念化的图像和影像艺术作品；不允许完全或部分由 AI 创造生成的作品。

奖项设置

奖项与奖金

US$5,600  总奖金（四类合计）

“家园”命题组的单片、组图两个类别，以及开放组的自然风光、艺术创意两个类别，每个类别分别设以下奖项：

奖项每类名额奖金
金奖1 名500 美元
银奖2 名每名 300 美元
铜奖3 名每名 100 美元
优秀奖若干名荣誉证书

作品基本要求

投稿须知

  • 必须是参赛者本人原创的手机、平板电脑或 iPad 拍摄作品。
  • 每幅参赛作品需标明作品名称，鼓励同时提供作品简单描述。
  • 作品彩色、黑白不限。
  • 作品不可以加水印、签名和边框。
  • 请作者保留作品的原始文件和完整的照片信息。必要时，主办方有权索要原始作品核对。
  • 作品拍摄时间不限。
  • 作品应为 JPEG 格式，长边不小于 1024 像素，文件大小不超过 10MB。
  • 不接受往届华盛顿手机摄影大赛各个类别的获奖作品。
  • 所有来稿一概不退。参加比赛即同意并授权大赛及组委会免费使用投稿作品做正面宣传及展示之用。
  • 大赛组委会和评委会成员不得参与本次比赛。
  • 不接受已经或拟用于商业用途的人像作品。凡参赛作品涉及可识别的个人肖像，作者须事先取得被摄者的授权，并确保作品不侵犯任何个人的隐私权和肖像权。由此产生的任何法律责任均由参赛者自行承担，大赛组委会不承担任何责任。
  • 不接受任何商业摄影中介组织承办送交的作品。
  • 18 岁以下青少年摄影师需由父母或成人委托人帮助送交作品。
  • 禁止宣扬暴力，或含有色情、低俗及其他不适宜公开展示内容的作品；禁止任何以商业广告或产品推广为主要目的的作品。
  • AI 技术使用基本规定：禁止提交任何完全或部分由生成式人工智能（Generative AI）生成的视觉元素。后期处理中允许使用修图软件中的基础 AI 辅助工具，例如降噪、蒙版、主体选择、影调调整等。

投稿与收费

投稿方式

每位作者最多可提交 6 幅作品（命题组图最多可投 3 组，每组按一幅作品计算）。

前 2 幅作品免费提交
第 3–6 幅作品每幅 10 美元（美国以外的参赛者可支付其他等值币种）

全球（中国大陆地区除外）

2026年11月1日至12月31日期间，通过大赛官网提交：www.gwmpa.org

中国大陆地区

通过微信投稿，投稿二维码将于 2026 年 10 月下旬公布。

前往投稿网站

大赛海报

下载中文海报   下载英文海报

问题反馈

如有任何疑问，请发邮件至 info.wcaf@gmail.com。大赛相关事宜的最终解释权归大赛组委会。

6th WIMPA · Judging Panel

The Jury

Every entry is judged anonymously, over multiple rounds, by an international panel of photographers, curators and educators from the United States, Canada, the Netherlands, Belgium and China.

YD
Specially Appointed Art Consultant

Yueheng Duan

Two-time recipient of the American Benny Gold Award (62nd and 70th ceremonies). His honors include the Sino-Canadian Cultural Outstanding Contribution Award from the Canadian government (2017), the Lifetime Achievement Award at the first Canadian IPF International Photography Festival (2015), and the Gold Award at the 5th China Printing Awards.

His work is held by numerous art institutions and private collectors. He has often judged international exhibitions and directed photography festivals, and has published three albums: Black and White World, Black and White Vision and Black and White Realm.

JF
Chair of the Jury

John Fan

A CUSPEA scholar who has lived in the United States for over 30 years, Dr. Fan has worked across physics, medicine and photography. He holds a Ph.D. in Physics, is a specialist in radiological medicine and a Fellow of the American Association of Physicists in Medicine (AAPM).

He is a curator and China Ambassador for the renowned online gallery 1x.com and a founding member of the Four Apertures Photography Team. His award-winning work is frequently published, has been shown in many international exhibitions, and is held by several image agencies.

JohnFanPhotography.com
MR
Judge

Max Rive

An internationally renowned landscape photographer known for powerful, distinctive portrayals of the natural world. Driven by a passion for fresh perspectives, he has explored and photographed some of the world's most remote and dramatic mountain landscapes. His compositions, adventurous spirit and highly recognizable style have earned him international acclaim and a strong global following.

maxrivephotography.com
YD
Judge

Yvette Depaepe

Based in Bruges, Belgium, Yvette is the Primary Magazine Editor of 1x.com. She began with analog photography, developing her own film in a home darkroom, exhibited in Belgium and won awards in numerous competitions before moving naturally to digital. For her, photography is less a profession than a way of life. As a WIMPA judge she looks beyond technical perfection: the soul, emotion and story in an image are what make a photograph meaningful and memorable.

1x.com/photoma
JG
Judge

Jin Gong

Former Senior Advisor to the U.S. Federal Reserve Board and a contracted photographer with China Tourism Press in Hong Kong, devoted to landscape photography for over twenty years. Honors include the Qilu International Photography Award at the 3rd Jinan International Photography Biennale (2010), a Bronze Award at the World Overseas Chinese Photography Exhibition (2013), and an Honorable Mention in the UN Arts Foundation's 2020 Travel Landscape competition. More than 100 of his photographs are in the Federal Reserve Board's collection.

SH
Judge

Shicheng Huang (Qi Shi Bu Yuan)

Holds dual degrees in arts and sciences from Tsinghua University and is a senior nuclear-power cost engineer with a passion for mobile photography. Former Vice President of the Atlantic Photographers Association and Vice Chairman and Art Mentor of the North American Mobile Photography Association; photojournalist for Maple Voice Canada; certified senior landscape photographer on TuChong. Honors include the 2020 CAPA Mobile Photography Club Gold Award and first place in the 2021 CAPA city category. Since 2020 he has given more than ten public mobile photography lectures and taught over 300 students.

1x.com/SeanHuang
EZ
Judge

Emma Zhao

Freelance photographer and instructor of practical mobile photography in Toronto, Vice President of the Atlantic Photographers Association and former Art Mentor of the North American Mobile Photography Association. Recent honors include the 2025 RHCC Theme Silver Award and 2025 CAPA Theme Honorable Mention, alongside the 2020 RHCC Black & White Macro Gold Award and the 2018 North American Mobile Photography Competition Gold Award (Art). Some 600 of her works are featured on 1x.com.

1x.com/emmazhao
LT
Judge

Lin Tan

Born in Hangzhou, Professor Tan studied mathematics at Zhejiang University and earned his Ph.D. in mathematics at UCLA, later teaching at Indiana University and West Chester University of Pennsylvania. Devoted to photography since 2006, he has held solo exhibitions in the U.S. and China and joined group shows at United Nations Headquarters, the Tianjin Art Museum and in New York. He has taught black-and-white and documentary photography at Guizhou University's School of Art, lectured at many universities, organized more than seventy talks for the "Time Micro-Classroom", and taught over one hundred lectures on Western art appreciation.

EY
Honorary Judge

Enpu Yang

Retired Professor at the Beijing Film Academy, Honorary Dean of Huaguang Photography College and Advisor to the China Overseas Chinese Photography Association. A filmmaker since graduating in 1961, his works include The Maritime Silk Road and the award-winning TV drama The Years of Studying with Zhou Enlai. Former Chair of the Theoretical Committee of the China Photographers Association, author of Fundamentals of Photographic Aesthetics and Introduction to Photographic Appreciation, and honored in 2006 as an Outstanding Photographer of New China.

第六届 WIMPA · 评委团队

评委

所有参赛作品均由来自美国、加拿大、荷兰、比利时和中国的摄影家、策展人和摄影教育者组成的国际评委会进行多轮匿名评审。

段
特聘艺术顾问

段岳衡

曾分别荣获美国第 62、70 届班尼金奖。2017 年获加拿大政府颁发的加中文化杰出贡献奖，2015 年获加拿大 IPF 首届国际摄影节终身成就奖，并获中华第五届印制大奖金奖。

摄影作品被多家艺术机构和个人收藏。多次出任国际摄影展览评委和摄影艺术节总监，出版《黑白世界》《黑白视界》《黑白适界》三本摄影艺术画册。

范
评委会主席

早年获李政道奖学金（CUSPEA），旅美三十余载，涉足物理、医学和摄影等不同领域。物理学博士，放射医学专家，美国医学物理学会院士。

About WIMPA

From a simple idea to an international competition

The competition is only the form; the platform is the purpose. WIMPA exists so that mobile photographers everywhere can share the stories around them and the feelings behind each image.

The 1st Awards: "Impressions of Washington"

The first Washington Mobile Photography Awards began with a down-to-earth idea: give mobile photography enthusiasts a place to share their work and tell the stories around them. Even the organizers were surprised by the response. Nearly 500 entries arrived, spanning nature, culture, documentary and creative work, and more than 3,000 people watched the online awards ceremony on February 5, 2022.

"Mobile photography may be amateur, but it is anything but low-grade."
Enpu Yang, Chair of the 1st Jury

The 2nd Awards: "Care"

The theme grew from a local impression to a universal one: stories of care between people and nature, between people, and between people and animals. Entries opened to the whole United States and Canada, a seven-member jury was formed, and around twenty photography clubs and community organizations joined as co-organizers.

The 3rd and 4th Awards: going international

The competition became the Washington International Mobile Photography Awards. The 4th edition, themed "Life", drew nearly 2,000 entries from eight countries, judged by nine photographers from China, the United States and Canada. Its awards ceremony in North Bethesda, Maryland welcomed nearly two hundred guests.

The 5th Awards

The 5th WIMPA introduced four themes (Everyday Life, Nature & Landscape, People & Documentary, and Art & Creativity) and the photo series format. Entries were received from November to December 2025, and the winners were celebrated in the Washington, D.C. area in 2026. See the 5th WIMPA winners

The 6th Awards: "Home"

The 6th WIMPA, Washington International Mobile Photography Awards 2026, carries the motto "Mobile Vision. Global Stories." It has two groups and four categories: the theme "Home" (single photo and photo series), and an Open Group for Nature & Landscape and Art & Creativity. Entries are open from November 1 to December 31, 2026, judged by an international jury that now includes Max Rive and Yvette Depaepe of 1x.com. Categories & rules

item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
关于 WIMPA

从一个创意到国际赛事

大赛只是形式，平台才是目的。WIMPA 希望世界各地的手机摄影爱好者，都能在这里分享身边的故事，以及每幅作品背后的情感。

首届：“华府印象”

首届华盛顿杯手机摄影大赛源于一个“接地气”的简单创意：给广大手机摄影爱好者搭建一个分享与交流的平台，让大家用手机讲述身边的故事。连组委会自己都没有预料到会有如此反响：大赛收到近 500 幅风格各异的作品，涵盖自然、人文、纪实、创意等多个方向。2022 年 2 月 5 日（大年初五）举行的线上颁奖典礼，在线观看人数超过 3000 人。

“手机摄影虽然业余，但不低档。”
首届评委会主席 杨恩璞

第二届：“关爱”

主题从地域性的“华府印象”升级为更具人文关怀的“关爱”：人与自然、人与人、人与动物之间彼此关爱的故事。征稿范围扩展到美国全境和加拿大，七位知名摄影师组成评委会，约二十个摄影团体及华人社团加盟协办。

第三、四届：走向国际

大赛升级为“华盛顿国际手机摄影大赛”。第四届以“生命”为主题，近两千幅来自八个国家的作品参赛，由中、美、加三国九位资深摄影专家评审。颁奖典礼在马里兰州 North Bethesda 举行，近两百名嘉宾出席。

第五届

第五届设日常生活、自然风光、人物纪实、艺术创意四大主题，并首次引入组图形式。作品征集于 2025 年 11 月至 12 月，颁奖典礼于 2026 年在大华府地区举行。查看第五届获奖作品

第六届：“家园”

第六届华盛顿国际手机摄影大赛（2026），口号是“手机视界，全球故事”。本届分为两大组、四个类别：命题组《家园》（单幅、组照），以及开放组的自然风光类和艺术创意类。征稿日期为 2026 年 11 月 1 日至 12 月 31 日，国际评委会新增 1x.com 的 Max Rive 和 Yvette Depaepe。参赛类别与规则

Yueheng Duan – Specially Appointed Art Consultant

Mr. Yueheng Duan is a two-time recipient of the American Benny Gold Award, earning the honor at the 62nd and 70th ceremonies. His accolades include the Sino-Canadian Cultural Outstanding Contribution Award from the Canadian government (2017), the Lifetime Achievement Award at the first Canadian IPF International Photography Festival (2015), and the Gold Award at the 5th China Printing Awards.
Mr. Duan’s photographic works are held in the collections of numerous art institutions and private collectors. He has also served as a judge for international photography exhibitions, directed photography art festivals, and published three photography art albums: Black and White World, Black and White Vision, and Black and White Realm.

John Fan – Chair

John Fan, PhD is a medical physicist in radiation oncology. Besides his outstanding professional career, John is also a world renowned photographer. He is the winner of many prestigious photography awards. His work has been published extensively in international magazines, books, and galleries. His books “Rational Inspiration” and “Talks about Photography” were published in 2017 and 2019 respectively. He is also a curator of the online photo gallery 1X.com and its China ambassador, and the co-founder of the acclaimed 4Aperture fine art photography group.

https://johnfanphotography.com

Ian Plant

Whether hanging over the rim of an active volcano or braving the elements to photograph critically endangered species, Ian Plant has spent the past two decades traveling the globe in his never-ending quest to capture the beauty of our world with his camera. Ian has reached hundreds of thousands of people in his mission to inspire and educate others in the art of photography. Ian is the author of dozens of books and instructional videos, an instructor for KelbyOne and other photography education outlets, and founder of Photo Masters, a site dedicated to photography education and inspiration.

https://ianplant.com/
https://www.photomasters.com

Hazel Meredith

Hazel Meredith is an award-winning photographer and a sought-after teacher, speaker, and competition judge. She began teaching in 2007, and now does seminars at camera clubs and conferences across the U.S. – both in-person and virtual. She offers her own workshops and webinars, and has done webinars for several software companies.
She has written two eBooks on working with textures, and released two creative courses. She and her husband, Dave, produce the “Virtual Creative Photography Conference” with attendees from around the world. Hazel loves the creative aspect of photography and post- processing, especially the use of textures and software to create unique images.
She is actively involved with the photographic community, and has held leadership roles and received honorary distinctions from several organizations. In the Fall of 2020 she was the recipient of the Ashbrook Award for Digital Imaging Instruction from the Photographic Society of America.

www.MeredithImages.com
www.MeredithImages.wordpress.com
www.Facebook.com/MeredithImages

Jin Gong

Former senior consultant of the Federal Reserve Board, Jin Gong, has over 20 years of experience as a landscape photographer. His pictures have received many awards and been published. He believes that photography is a continuous process of challenging oneself and pursuing perfection, as well as a dialogue between humans and nature.

Shicheng Huang

Shicheng Huang is an advisor to the Atlantic Photographers Association (APA), former Vice Chairman of the North American Mobile Photography Association (NAMPA), and an art mentor. He is a member of several photography associations in North America and serves as a photojournalist for the Manitoba Chinese Tribune. His works have won numerous awards in various photography competitions. He is the founder of a practical mobile photography course and a senior lecturer, as well as a certified landscape photographer by Tuchong. He has served multiple times as a judge and head judge in photography competitions. In 2021, he was one of the panel speakers for the Xinflix Media “Poems in Dream, Hand in Hand, Heart with Heart” TV Photography Forum.

Enpu Yang

Retired Professor at Beijing Film Academy, Honorary Dean of Huaguang Photography College, and Advisor to the China Overseas Chinese Photography Association.
He graduated from Beijing Film Academy in 1961 and has devoted his career to film and television production, creating a large number of documentaries and educational films. Representative works include The Maritime Silk Road and Photography Guide.
Since the 1990s, he has also been involved in screenwriting and directing television dramas. A notable work is The Years of Studying with Zhou Enlai, which won the Second Prize of the Flying Apsaras Awards (Feitian Awards) and the Excellent Short TV Drama Award at the Golden Eagle Awards.
He previously served as Chair of the Theoretical Committee of the China Photographers Association and has frequently been a judge for both national and international photography competitions.
He has authored several influential books, including Fundamentals of Photographic Aesthetics and Introduction to Photographic Appreciation.
He has published over a million words of articles and hundreds of photographs in newspapers and magazines both domestically and internationally. His academic papers, such as An Analysis of Chinese Academic-Style Cinema, have won awards at home and abroad.
In 2006, he was honored by the China Photographers Association as one of the “Outstanding Photographers of the 50th Anniversary of the Founding of New China.”

Emma Zhao

Currently residing in Toronto, Canada.
Certified interpreter in Ontario,
freelance photographer,
real estate photographer,
owner of Emma Photography Studio.
Former Vice President of the Atlantic Photographers Association.
Former Art Instructor for the North American Mobile Photography Association.
Photography works have won numerous awards in domestic and international photography competitions, including:

• 2020 RHCC Black and White Macro First Prize
• 2019 TIPF Best Folklore Award
• 2019 TIPF Vanguard Photography Medal Award
• 2019 Canada Dream Cabinet Cup Photography Competition Silver Award
• 2018 North American Mobile Photography Competition Art Category Gold Award
• 2018 TIPF Vanguard Photography Medal Award
• 2017 TIPF International Photography Festival Excellence Award
• 2017 JEPA Fall Competition Gold Award
• 124 Toronto Photography Salon Excellence Award
• 2017 PSA Art Category Excellence Award
• 2017 CAPA Art Category Excellence Award

Jin Gong – Chair

Former senior consultant of the Federal Reserve Board, Jin Gong, has over 20 years of experience as a landscape photographer. His pictures have received many awards and been published. He believes that photography is a continuous process of challenging oneself and pursuing perfection, as well as a dialogue between humans and nature.

Ian Plant

Whether hanging over the rim of an active volcano or braving the elements to photograph critically endangered species, Ian Plant has spent the past two decades traveling the globe in his never-ending quest to capture the beauty of our world with his camera. Ian has reached hundreds of thousands of people in his mission to inspire and educate others in the art of photography. Ian is the author of dozens of books and instructional videos, an instructor for KelbyOne and other photography education outlets, and founder of Photo Masters, a site dedicated to photography education and inspiration.

https://ianplant.com/
https://www.photomasters.com

[/ppb_image_half_fixed_width]

Hazel Meredith

Hazel Meredith is an award-winning photographer and a sought-after teacher, speaker, and competition judge. She began teaching in 2007, and now does seminars at camera clubs and conferences across the U.S. – both in-person and virtual. She offers her own workshops and webinars, and has done webinars for several software companies.
She has written two eBooks on working with textures, and released two creative courses. She and her husband, Dave, produce the “Virtual Creative Photography Conference” with attendees from around the world. Hazel loves the creative aspect of photography and post- processing, especially the use of textures and software to create unique images.
She is actively involved with the photographic community, and has held leadership roles and received honorary distinctions from several organizations. In the Fall of 2020 she was the recipient of the Ashbrook Award for Digital Imaging Instruction from the Photographic Society of America.

www.MeredithImages.com
www.MeredithImages.wordpress.com
www.Facebook.com/MeredithImages

Weike Zhao

Mr. Weike Zhao is a long-time documentary and street photographer. He was shortlisted in 1992 in China for the Top Ten Chinese Young Photographer Award. In 1993 Mr. Zhao held his solo photo exhibition “Impression of the American West” and “American Cowboy” in China in 2005. From 2006 – 2009, Mr. Zhao worked as a photo editor for the US Marine Corps under the contract between Washington Post and the US Department of Defense. In 2007 he won the first place of US Marine Corps Combat Correspondent Association Award and in 2008 the first place of US Department of Defense Thomas Jefferson Award. In 2015, he was invited as a guest speaker to the opening ceremony of Beijing International Photography Week in China. In the same year, he was invited as the keynote speaker to the Sino-US Vivian Maire’s Photography Symposium in China. In 2020, he held a solo photo exhibition “Amish’s Spring” at the 8th Jinan International Biennale Photography Exhibition in China and won the Outstanding Photographer award of the Event. In 2024, he served as the executive director as well as the judge for the First Worldwide Overseas Chinese Humanist Photography Award.

Shicheng Huang

Shicheng Huang is an advisor to the Atlantic Photographers Association (APA), former Vice Chairman of the North American Mobile Photography Association (NAMPA), and an art mentor. He is a member of several photography associations in North America and serves as a photojournalist for the Manitoba Chinese Tribune. His works have won numerous awards in various photography competitions. He is the founder of a practical mobile photography course and a senior lecturer, as well as a certified landscape photographer by Tuchong. He has served multiple times as a judge and head judge in photography competitions. In 2021, he was one of the panel speakers for the Xinflix Media “Poems in Dream, Hand in Hand, Heart with Heart” TV Photography Forum.

Emma Zhao

Currently residing in Toronto, Canada.
Certified interpreter in Ontario,
freelance photographer,
real estate photographer,
owner of Emma Photography Studio.
Former Vice President of the Atlantic Photographers Association.
Former Art Instructor for the North American Mobile Photography Association.
Photography works have won numerous awards in domestic and international photography competitions, including:

• 2020 RHCC Black and White Macro First Prize
• 2019 TIPF Best Folklore Award
• 2019 TIPF Vanguard Photography Medal Award
• 2019 Canada Dream Cabinet Cup Photography Competition Silver Award
• 2018 North American Mobile Photography Competition Art Category Gold Award
• 2018 TIPF Vanguard Photography Medal Award
• 2017 TIPF International Photography Festival Excellence Award
• 2017 JEPA Fall Competition Gold Award
• 124 Toronto Photography Salon Excellence Award
• 2017 PSA Art Category Excellence Award
• 2017 CAPA Art Category Excellence Award

Some works are included in renowned photography art galleries ：1x.com/emmazhao

John Fan

John Fan, PhD is a medical physicist in radiation oncology. Besides his outstanding professional career, John is also a world renowned photographer. He is the winner of many prestigious photography awards. His work has been published extensively in international magazines, books, and galleries. His books “Rational Inspiration” and “Talks about Photography” were published in 2017 and 2019 respectively. He is also a curator of the online photo gallery 1X.com and its China ambassador, and the co-founder of the acclaimed 4Aperture fine art photography group.

https://johnfanphotography.com/

Hua Zhu

Hua Zhu, Ph.D. from Columbia, USA, professor at Rutgers – New Jersey Medical School, and a landscape photographer. For more than 20 years, he traveled all over the world. His group pictures won the gold medal in the “Foreigners Looking at Beijing” photography competition; his wide-format works in Banff won the only annual grand award in the 5th Sony Natural Color Annual Competition; in 2017, he was invited to participate in the first global Chinese Photography Art Exhibition and served as a judge and a special lecture guest on photography; in 2017 and 2019, he held two personal photography exhibitions at the China Photography Exhibition Hall of the Chinese Photographers Society; his “Night Lights” was selected by National Geographic Photo of the Day for January 1, 2018.

Some of his photos were posted on: https://1x.com/huazhu.

1.   Mission

Our mission is to cultivate a vibrant community of mobile photography enthusiasts, both amateur and professional, providing a platform for sharing, learning, and artistic expression. Through the Greater Washington Mobile Photography Awards (“Awards”), we aim to inspire creativity, promote cultural exchange, and celebrate the beauty of everyday life captured through the lens of a mobile device. We strive to encourage participants to explore and appreciate the world around them and narrate the stories behind their images, reflecting on the rich tapestry of life and fostering a deeper connection to their surroundings and a greater appreciation for the art of photography.

2.   Organizers:

·       Washington Cultural Arts Foundation (WCAF)

·       Greater Washington DC Northeast Chinese Association (DAGW)

·       Chinese Culture and Community Service Center Photo Club (CCACC Photo Club)

·       Raying Photograph Studio 

3.   Submission Categories:

3.1. The submissions of Awards comprises two categories: Themed category and Open category.

3.2. Themed category

3.2.1.   Subject: Journey

3.2.2.   Description: Employ your footsteps, eyes, and heart to measure, capture, and appreciate the scenic beauty, cultural heritage, architecture, street life, wildlife, and flora encountered during your journey. Utilize your mobile device to convey the sights and experiences of your journey, offering personal insights and reflections.

3.2.3.   Content Classes:

3.2.3.1.      Natural Scenery of the Journey

3.2.3.2.      Cultural and Humanistic Aspects of the Journey

3.2.3.3.      Animals and Plants of the Journey

3.2.3.4.      Experience and Insights of the Journey

3.2.4.   Requirements:

3.2.4.1.    This category of work falls under the documentary genre, with no restrictions on whether it is in color or monochrome.

3.2.4.2.    Adjustments to brightness, contrast, and color saturation of the work are permissible within reason.

3.2.4.3.    Cropping is permitted.

3.2.4.4.    Any addition, removal, or replacement of elements within the original image is not allowed.

3.2.5.   Awards:

3.2.5.1.      Each class features the following four award levels.

3.2.5.1.1.         Gold Award: one, $300

3.2.5.1.2.         Silver Award: three, $200 each

3.2.5.1.3.         Bronze Awards: five, $100 each

3.2.5.1.4.         Honorable Mentions: vary, Certificates of Honor

3.3. Open category

3.3.1.   Description: the submissions may on any theme except for “Journey.”

3.3.2.   Content classes:

3.3.2.1.      Nature and Scenery

3.3.2.1.1.      Submissions should prominently feature natural elements or landscapes.

3.3.2.1.2.      Natural elements may include animals, plants, or natural phenomena.

3.3.2.1.3.       Landscape submissions should predominantly showcase landscapes.

3.3.2.1.4.         Acceptable post-processing for this category includes:

3.3.2.1.4.1.     Adjustments to brightness, contrast, and color saturation.

3.3.2.1.4.2.     Cropping to enhance composition.

3.3.2.1.4.3.     Removal of imperfections such as spots and noise.

3.3.2.1.5.         Unacceptable post-processing for this category includes:

3.3.2.1.5.1.     Adding, replacing, or moving elements within the composition.

3.3.2.1.5.2.     Altering the original scene’s composition.

3.3.2.2.      People and Documentary

3.3.2.2.1.         Description: Entries should capture human cultural activities and humanistic landscapes.

3.3.2.2.2.         Acceptable post-processing for this category includes:

3.3.2.2.2.1.   Adjustments to brightness, contrast, and color saturation.

3.3.2.2.2.2.  Cropping to improve composition.

3.3.2.2.3.         Unacceptable post-processing for this category includes:

3.3.2.2.3.1.   Adding, removing, or replacing elements within the original image.

3.3.2.3.      Art and Creativity

3.3.2.3.1.         Description: submissions should creatively interpret the theme.

3.3.2.3.2.         Acceptable post-processing for this category includes:

3.3.2.3.2.1.   No restrictions on creative editing or post-processing techniques.

3.3.2.3.2.2.   Post-processing to create surreal or conceptual images and video art is permitted.

3.3.2.3.3.         Unacceptable post-processing for this category includes:

3.3.2.3.3.1.     Use of purely AI-generated images.

3.3.3.   Awards:

3.3.3.1.      Each class features the following four award levels.

3.3.3.1.1.         Gold Award: one, $300

3.3.3.1.2.         Silver Award: three, $200 each

3.3.3.1.3.         Bronze Awards: five, $100 each

3.3.3.1.4.         Honorable Mentions: vary, Certificates of Honor

4.   Judges:

4.1. Chief Judge: Huang Shicheng

4.2. Judges: Weike Zhao, Enpu Yang, Jin Gong, Emma Zhao, John Fan, Hua Zhu,

5.   Submission Period:

5.1. September 1, 2023 to September 30, 2023 (Eastern Time)

6.   Submission Requirements:

6.1. Original photographs taken with a mobile, tablet, or iPad.

6.2. Each entry must be titled, with a recommended brief description.

6.3. Color or black-and-white photos are accepted.

6.4. No watermarks, signatures, or borders allowed.

6.5. Retain the original files and complete photo information. Winners may be required to provide original files if necessary.

6.6. No restrictions on the time of shooting.

6.7. Photos must be in JPEG format.

6.8. The long edge of the photo should be no less than 1024 pixels. File size should not exceed 5MB.

6.9. All submissions are final and non-refundable.

7.   Submission Fees:

7.1. Each author is eligible to submit up to 5 entries.

7.2. First 2 entries: Free

7.3. 3rd to 5th entries: Fee required

7.3.1.   Outside China: 5.00 USD per entry

7.3.2.   China: 40 RMB per entry

8.   Submission:

8.1. For all entries except those from Chinese mainland:

Submit through the Greater Washington Mobile Photography Awards ‘s official website: http://www.gwmpa.org

8.2. For entries from Chinese mainland:

Register and submit through the WeChat program by scanning the QR code provided.

9.   Disclaimer:

9.1. By participating, authors grant permission for the Greater Washington Mobile Photography Awards and organizing committee to use their submissions for promotional and display purposes free of charge.

9.2. Members of the organizing committee and judges are ineligible to participate.

9.3. The organizing committee reserves the right of final interpretation of all matters related to the Greater Washington Mobile Photography Awards.

10.       Contact:

10.1.    For inquiries or more information, please email info.wcaf@gmail.com

11.       Support:

11.1.    For sponsorship inquiries, please contact Xu Jiang at 240-805-8095.

大华府地区不仅是我们很多人的第二故乡，作为美国首都更是一个具有特别意义的城市。这里有庄严的白宫、恢宏的国会山、高耸的华盛顿纪念碑和四处遍布的博物馆、纪念地，完整地囊括了美国文化的内涵 – 自由与包容，平等与博爱。

Read More

这里不仅有美丽的风景，更发生着许许多多令人难以忘怀，载入史册的人文事件。选“华府印象”作为作为本次大赛的主题，是希望大家通过快捷方便的手机照片来分享记录家园美景、记录生活中的真、善、美，以及打动人心的美好瞬间，体会感恩大自然的美好，用图片和光影来讲述华府的故事。

Read More

在11月8日截止日期前，大赛组委会共收到480张参赛作品。其中，风光类247幅，艺术类61幅，人文类172幅。参赛者既有当地知名的摄影师，也有手机摄影的初学者，但每一位参赛者都对大赛倾注了极大的热情。

item.content:encoded:
Transform fleeting moments into timeless memories with your phone.

The Greater Washington Mobile Photography Awards (“Awards”) is initiated and hosted by the Washington Cultural Arts Foundation (WCAF). The annual Awards serves as a global platform for mobile photography enthusiasts, both amateurs and professionals, to share, connect, and celebrate the art of capturing life’s most captivating moments through the lens of a mobile device, transcending geographical and cultural boundaries. It’s a place where the beauty of mobile photography intertwines with the compelling stories and diverse emotions behind each photograph.

Established in 2021, the Awards quickly gained international acclaim for its high-caliber entries and a panel of expert judges from the world of photography. Since its inception, the Awards has witnessed double growth, with each edition surpassing the last. The third edition in 2023 saw over 1,000 entries from almost 500 participants, not only from the United States but also from China, Australia, Southeast Asia, and European countries. The remarkable expansion has elevated the competition to an internationally recognized platform, setting the stage for the fourth edition in 2024, which will be rebranded as the “Greater Washington International Mobile Photography Awards”. Anticipated to attract over 1,000 participants and showcase more than 3,000 entries, this edition promises to be the most captivating yet.

Supported by over 30 esteemed photography organizations worldwide, including the Atlantic Photographers Association, the New York Photography Society, the San Francisco Photographer Alliance, and the Canadian International Photography Association, the Awards has become a beacon for mobile photography enthusiasts. Additionally, it has fostered a vibrant community of thousands, actively engaged in sharing their work and participating in expert-led critiques, mobile photography lectures, photography tours, and other enriching activities organized by the Organizing Committee of the Awards.

The fourth edition of the Awards will commence its call for entries in October 2024, with the updated rules set to be unveiled in May 2024. The prestigious award ceremony is slated for March 2025, coinciding with the blooming of cherry blossoms, a symbol of beauty and renewal.

We extend a warm invitation to mobile photography enthusiasts worldwide to participate in this extraordinary event. Join us in the vibrant capital of the United States, Washington, D.C., for a celebration of creativity, talent, and the art of mobile photography.

For inquiries, please contact us at: info.wcaf@gmail.com

早年获李政道奖学金（CUSPEA），旅美三十余载，涉足物理，医学和摄影等不同领域。为物理学博士，放射医学专家。作品在国际摄影界屡获殊荣,  频繁发表在国内外出版物，在多个国际展览中展出，并被多家图片社收藏。

美籍华人摄影师，哥伦比亚大学生物化学博士。受父亲影响自幼喜爱摄影。十几年来行走于世界各地，摄影作品和文章曾在众多杂志、书籍和网站上发表, 并多次获得摄影比赛大奖。
